target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Already maintains a transparency portal with public records, agendas, and financial reports. Enhanced civic insight tools could improve data visualization and citizen accessibility to county information.

actual_brand_research.mission: Improve access to information, ability to participate in county events, and communication with the county
actual_brand_research.focus: Government transparency and open access to public records

brandkit_for_mvp.proposed_tagline: Your County. Your Data. Your Voice.
brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: The civic insight platform for Ashtabula County — enhancing transparency with interactive dashboards, meeting alerts, and citizen engagement tools.

visual_direction.hero_image_concept: Interactive dashboard showing county data and civic participation
visual_direction.color_scheme: Official government blues conveying trust and authority
visual_direction.photography_style: County buildings, public meetings, community engagement

implementation_recommendations.brand_alignment: Align with Ashtabula County's transparency and accessibility mission
key_features_needed: Interactive dashboards for budgets and spending
GIS mapping for zoning and development
Elected official profiles with voting records
differentiators_based_on_research: Open records and open meetings focus
